verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe automations as scheduled, cron-like agent runs that execute a prompt in a fresh or existing workspace. Each run produces a live workspace to review and continue, and automations can be managed through the CLI (including from CI), the TypeScript SDK, and the MCP server, whose live endpoint exposes automation tools. A community user also praises the background service that keeps sessions alive. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of scheduled automations specifically; no clarity on whether automations run when the desktop app or local host is offline; automations appear to be gated to a paid plan.
